content.question: Match various metrics with the most suitable situations to apply them.

answer.precision: When each false positive is costly, e.g. flagging a legitimate email as spam
answer.recall: When each false negative is costly, e.g. missing a dangerous disease diagnosis
answer.F1-score: When you need a balance between precision and recall, especially on imbalanced classes, e.g. fraud detection where both missing a fraud and wrongly blocking a legitimate transaction are costly
answer.accuracy: When the classes are balanced and both error types cost roughly the same, e.g. classifying images of two equally represented categories where any mistake is equally bad
